pcs.pc_description: Gather information on the scope of the product by collaborating with other relevant stakeholders.

Outline an overall plan for test automation strategy for device/platform solution

Create the test plan to cover all the requirements and prepare a requirement traceability matrix

Collaborate with relevant teams (strategy, development, etc.) to develop a set of processes and standards for test automation
Test the integration of the AR VR product/solution fully into the client's existing SDLC cadence

Design tests to ensure that the hardware is working properly
Test whether the hardware is compatible with the software and other devices used in the simulation
Develop tests to ensure the network environment supports the solution.
Test the accessories used in the solution and ensure it fits the audience's body correctly
Include all possible environment set-ups and user scenarios (e.g., home environment, public spaces, sounds in the background, etc.) while developing the tests/simulations
Access reusable scenarios, test cases, scripts, and tools from the organization’s knowledge base
Access or create test data relevant to the requirements
Validate the test plan, test cases, and/or automated scripts with appropriate people

modules.module_title: Identify, document, and track defects and issues found — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Systematically test the application through various techniques, including functional testing, usability testing, and performance testing. Identify issues such as bugs, glitches, user interface inconsistencies, and performance bottlenecks.

Employ testing tools and frameworks suitable for AR/VR applications (such as Unity Test Framework or software testing suites) to aid in identifying defects. Automated testing scripts may also be used for regression testing to ensure that previously functioning features remain stable after updates
For each identified defect, document detailed information

Utilize issue tracking tools (such as Jira, Bugzilla, or Trello) to log defects and manage their lifecycle. This allows for organized tracking of reported issues, making it easier for the team to view the status and history of each defect
Assign defects to appropriate team members (developers, product managers) based on expertise and responsibility, ensuring accountability for resolution
Maintain open lines of communication with the development team. Provide regular updates on discovered defects, especially if new critical issues arise during ongoing testing.
Arrange meetings or forums for testers and developers to discuss defects in more detail, seeking clarifications on the issues identified and potential solutions
Be available to assist developers in understanding the context of the defects. A collaborative approach can lead to quicker identification of the root causes and more effective solutions.

After developers implement fixes, conduct retesting to verify that the issues have been resolved. This includes checking that the defect no longer occurs and that no new issues have been introduced as a result of the changes
Perform regression testing to confirm that other functionalities remain unaffected by the fixes, ensuring overall stability and performance of the application.
Update defect documentation with the status of the defects once resolved, including the solutions implemented. This serves as a historical record that can be useful for future reference

Generate reports summarizing testing outcomes, including both identified defects and their resolutions. Include metrics such as defect totals, severity distribution, and trends observed during testing cycles
Regularly analyze collected defect data to identify recurring issues or trends. This analysis can guide improvements in both testing practices and development processes.
Encourage feedback from developers and other team members about the defect reporting process to optimize efficiency and clarity in communication
